description: Use when the user wants the full text of one published IndustryLens report (after finding its slug via list_reports). Fetch the full body of a published report by slug. Returns the report's structured fields plus content_html (the canonical body) and the report's web URL. There is no standalone hosted PDF file — `pdf_url` is always null (verified live: the marketing_reports.pdf_url column is unpopulated for every published report; an earlier version of this description incorrectly claimed a real generated-PDF link existed). A PDF IS available, but gated by design: `pdf_download.url` is the report's own web page, where a 'Download PDF' button opens after the reader submits a work email (IndustryLens's deliberate lead-capture gate) and then renders the PDF client-side in the browser via print-to-PDF — there is no URL an MCP client (or anything else) can fetch directly to get the PDF bytes. Never construct or guess a .pdf URL yourself; point the user at `pdf_download.url` (same as `url`) and tell them a work email is required.
name: get_report
title: Get a full IndustryLens report
